youtube.title: Um. Uh. Hmm. Proposed for cutting: new in funkbox's cut plan, plus subtitles that keep off faces
youtube.description:
Um. Uh. Hmm. Proposed for cutting.
New in funkbox: the cut plan flags filler words (Hebrew filler sounds too), and burned-in subtitles keep off faces.
Free, open source, runs locally: https://github.com/IsraelWebDev/funkbox
